Maaco’s first release came in 1992, with a group called “One Nation” and he later hooked up with DJ PDOG and together they formed M.A.P. Records. They put out stuff on their own label as Detroit In Effect and later hooked up with SERGE of CLONE Records. DJ Maaco has since then played numerous times in Europe and the U.K. dropping raw insistent electro and Detroit bass music that moves bodies!
